video_prompt_package.prompt:
SUBJECT:
Subject: Nigerian first-time mother, day 6 after C-section, seated on the edge of a bed
Posture: seated, leaning slightly forward
Expression: guarded, cautious
Wardrobe: simple nightclothes
Identity continuity: same woman across shots; stable facial identity; consistent day-6 postpartum context
Permitted actions: slowly shift weight forward; begin to rise carefully

ENVIRONMENT:
Location: bedroom
Time of day: approximately 3 AM (night)
Lighting: warm bedside lamp
Props: bed, bedside lamp
Cultural markers: Nigerian
Background: quiet, dim domestic bedroom

START STATE:
Visual state: seated on the edge of the bed
Subject position: edge of the bed
Camera position: static medium-wide, side-on
Emotional state: guarded discomfort
Visible objects: bed, bedside lamp

ACTION:
Primary action: She slowly shifts her weight forward in preparation to rise.
Gestures: hands ready to steady herself
Shot actions: SHOT-CSEC-006-1: She slowly shifts her weight forward in preparation to rise.

CAMERA:
Framing: medium-wide
Position: static, side-on to the bed edge
Movement: none (locked-off)
Focus: subject stays in focus
Stability: fully stable / locked
Shot camera: SHOT-CSEC-006-1: medium-wide, none, locked

MOTION:
Speed: slow, cautious
Direction: forward / upward
Physical constraints: no abrupt movement; no weight loaded onto the wound
Principle: Use the minimum motion necessary to communicate the validated angle. No cinematic sweeping cameras, dramatic body movement, exaggerated emotional performance, constant background movement, or gratuitous transitions unless explicitly required by the spec.

TIMING:
Total duration (s): 6
Shot durations: SHOT-CSEC-006-1=6s
Action timing: 0-2s: hesitation; 2-5s: slow forward weight shift; 5-6s: partial rise hold
Hold timing: 5-6s: hold the careful position

END STATE:
Visual state: careful partially upright / standing-lean position
Subject position: at the edge of the bed, partially risen
Emotional state: cautious, controlled discomfort (not agony)
Intended meaning: the unspoken difficulty of a simple movement is real and ordinary

CONTINUITY:
Identity: consistent subject identity
Wardrobe: unchanged
Objects: bed and lamp consistent
Environment: same bedroom, same lighting
Body anatomy: believable human anatomy

AUDIO:
Mode: NONE

TEXT POLICY:
Generated text allowed: false
Deterministic overlay text: (applied deterministically downstream)
Captions: true
CTA: true
Logo: true

DO NOT SHOW:
collapse; fall; exaggerated writhing; falling; collapsing; fast or jerky motion; no text rendered inside the scene; no staged fall; no dramatic collapsing; no stereotyping; no invented cultural markers; no unsafe physical demonstration framed as clinical instruction; no medical-device invention; no malformed anatomy
